subScenes.name: 确认预订
subScenes.description: 旅客向前台确认预订信息，提供姓名和预订号。

qaPairs.triggerText: May I have your name and reservation number, please?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请问您的姓名和预订编号是多少？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台确认预订信息

followUps.text: I'm Sarah Chen, and my reservation number is R78923.
followUps.text_cn: 我是陈莎拉，预订编号是R78923。

followUps.text: I'm not sure about the number, but my name is David Wong. Can you check under that?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太记得编号了，但我叫王大伟，能用名字查一下吗？

followUps.text: I think I didn't make a reservation—can I still check in?
followUps.text_cn: 我想我好像没预订，还能办理入住吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于酒店前台核实预订身份，用户可能有预订、部分信息遗忘或无预订三种情况

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you book a room with a view or a specific floor?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您预订的是有景观的房间还是特定楼层的房间？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认房间偏好是否被满足

followUps.text: Yes, I booked a high-floor room with an ocean view.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我订了高层海景房。

followUps.text: I didn't specify—I'm fine with any available room.
followUps.text_cn: 我没特别说明，任何房间都可以。

followUps.text: I asked for a non-smoking room—was that included?
followUps.text_cn: 我要求的是无烟房，这个有包含吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于确认用户是否提出特殊房间要求，回应需体现不同态度与关注点

qaPairs.triggerText: Is your reservation under the name of Anderson?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您的预订是用安德森这个名字做的吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 核对预订姓名是否与证件一致

followUps.text: Yes, that's me—I booked it under my last name.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，是我，我用的是姓氏预订的。

followUps.text: Actually, I booked it under my middle name—Liam. Can you look that up?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我用的是中间名Liam，能帮我查一下吗？

followUps.text: No, I think someone else made it for me—can you check under Jessica Moore?
followUps.text_cn: 不是，是别人帮我订的，能查一下杰西卡·摩尔吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于核实预订姓名与实际入住人是否一致，常见于代订、使用别名或拼写差异场景

subScenes.name: 出示证件
subScenes.description: 旅客出示护照，前台核对身份并登记信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Could I see your ID and passport, please?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请出示您的身份证和护照，好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台要求出示证件以办理入住

followUps.text: Sure, here's my passport and national ID.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，这是我的护照和身份证。

followUps.text: I only have my passport—my ID is at home. Is that okay?
followUps.text_cn: 我只带了护照，身份证在家。这样可以吗？

followUps.text: Oops, I left my passport in the car. Can I go get it?
followUps.text_cn: 糟了，我把护照忘在车里了，我能回去拿吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于酒店入住时前台核验身份的典型对话，用户需根据自身证件情况灵活回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a reservation under your name?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您有以您名字预订的房间吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台确认预订信息后要求出示证件

followUps.text: Yes, it's under John Smith. Here's my passport.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，是约翰·史密斯的预订，这是我的护照。

followUps.text: I booked it for my colleague—his name is David Lee. Can I check in with his booking?
followUps.text_cn: 我帮同事订的，名字是大卫·李。我能用他的预订信息入住吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I’m not sure—I think it was under my company’s name. Can you check?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我不太确定，可能是用公司名义订的。您能帮我查一下吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当前台确认预订归属时，用户需清晰说明预订主体，涵盖个人、代订、公司订房三种常见情形

qaPairs.triggerText: Is this your only form of identification?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台对证件完整性存疑，进一步确认

followUps.text: Yes, just my passport. I don’t carry my national ID when traveling.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，只有护照。我旅行时从不带身份证。

followUps.text: I also have my driver’s license—would that help?
followUps.text_cn: 我还有一张驾照，这个有用吗？

followUps.text: I’m sorry, I lost my ID last week. Is there another way to verify me?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我上周丢了我的身份证。还有其他方式能验证我吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当前台对证件有效性存疑时，用户需根据不同证件状况做出合理回应，体现真实场景中的应变能力

subScenes.name: 支付押金
subScenes.description: 前台说明押金金额，旅客用信用卡或现金支付。

qaPairs.triggerText: We need a deposit of $100 for incidentals. How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们需要100美元的押金作为杂费，您想怎么支付？

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I don't have a card on me.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我没带卡。

followUps.text: Can I pay it later when I check out?
followUps.text_cn: 我可以在退房时再付押金吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是酒店前台最常问的押金支付方式问题，用户需根据自身支付方式或财务状况灵活回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: The deposit will be refunded after checkout, minus any charges. Is that okay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 押金会在退房时退还，扣除任何额外费用。您同意吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店入住时确认押金退还条款

followUps.text: Yes, that's fine with me.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，我没问题。

followUps.text: What counts as a charge? I don't want surprises.
followUps.text_cn: 哪些算额外费用？我不想有意外扣款。

followUps.text: Can I leave a smaller deposit? I'm on a tight budget.
followUps.text_cn: 我能付少一点押金吗？我预算紧张。

qaPairs.usageNote: 客人常对押金退还规则有疑虑，需能主动询问细节或协商，体现真实沟通能力。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to use the same card for the deposit as your reservation?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想用和预订时相同的卡来支付押金吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台确认押金支付卡是否与预订一致

followUps.text: Yes, please use the same card.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，请用同一张卡。

followUps.text: No, I'd like to use a different card this time.
followUps.text_cn: 不，我想换一张卡支付。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—can I check with my bank first?
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定，我可以先问问银行吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 此问题涉及支付安全与便利性，用户可能因安全、卡状态或财务安排产生不同反应，需掌握自然回应方式。

subScenes.name: 询问设施
subScenes.description: 旅客询问房间WiFi密码和早餐时间等服务信息。

followUps.text: It's on the second floor, next to the swimming pool.
followUps.text_cn: 在二楼，游泳池旁边。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, the fitness center is currently closed for maintenance until tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，健身中心正在维修，明天才开放。

followUps.text: We don't have a fitness center, but there's a gym just a 5-minute walk away.
followUps.text_cn: 我们酒店没有健身中心，但步行五分钟有一家健身房。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于询问酒店内部设施位置，常见于入住后立即咨询的场景

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there a laundry service available?

followUps.text: Yes, we offer same-day laundry service if you drop it off before 10 a.m.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，如果您在上午10点前送交，可当天取回。

followUps.text: We only do dry cleaning, not regular laundry.
followUps.text_cn: 我们只提供干洗，不洗普通衣物。

followUps.text: We don't have an in-house laundry service, but we can recommend a nearby laundromat.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有内部洗衣服务，但可以推荐附近一家自助洗衣店。

qaPairs.usageNote: 客人常在出行前或行程中询问洗衣服务，需明确服务范围和限制

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a business center with printing?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 有提供打印服务的商务中心吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 询问商务设施与打印服务

followUps.text: Yes, the business center is on the first floor, and printing is free for guests.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，商务中心在一楼，住客可免费打印。

followUps.text: We have a business center, but printing costs $1 per page.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有商务中心，但打印每页收费1美元。

followUps.text: We don't have a business center, but I can help you print at the front desk for a small fee.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有商务中心，但我可以在前台帮您打印，收取少量费用。

qaPairs.usageNote: 商务旅客高频需求，需区分是否收费、是否需预约、是否支持自助

subScenes.name: 领取房卡
subScenes.description: 前台发放房卡，指引房间位置并致意告别。

qaPairs.triggerText: May I have your name and reservation number, please?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请问您的姓名和预订号是多少？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台核对入住信息以发放房卡

followUps.text: Sure, it's Sarah Chen, reservation number R7892.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，我是陈莎拉，预订号是R7892。

followUps.text: I'm not sure about the number—can you check under John Smith?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太记得编号了，能用约翰·史密斯的名字查一下吗？

followUps.text: I don't have a reservation—I just walked in.
followUps.text_cn: 我没有预订，是直接过来的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是入住流程的第一步，用于确认身份和预订状态，用户需提供准确信息或说明特殊情况。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like a high floor or a room with a view?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您希望住高楼层还是有景观的房间？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台根据偏好分配房间类型以发放房卡

followUps.text: A high floor, please—I like the view from up top.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我高楼层，我喜欢从高处看风景。

followUps.text: Either is fine, whatever’s available.
followUps.text_cn: 哪个都行，有空房就行。

followUps.text: Do you have any rooms facing the pool?
followUps.text_cn: 有朝向泳池的房间吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 前台常提供房间选择以提升体验，用户可表达偏好、妥协或提出定制需求。

qaPairs.triggerText: Here’s your key card. Would you like help with your luggage?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这是您的房卡。需要帮忙搬行李吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 发放房卡后提供行李协助服务

followUps.text: Yes, please—I have two heavy suitcases.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，谢谢，我有两个重行李箱。

followUps.text: No, thanks—I’m all set.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我自己可以。

followUps.text: Could you just show me where the elevator is?
followUps.text_cn: 您能告诉我电梯在哪吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 房卡发放后常伴随服务延伸，用户可根据体力、习惯或情境选择接受、拒绝或调整协助方式。
